name: shomra
description: Gate and fix AI artifacts (MCP servers, Skills, rules, hooks) and flag known-vulnerable AI models right in your editor. Works in VS Code and Cursor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: NoFly runs the local `nofly` CLI, so it only activates in trusted workspaces.

commands.title: Check AI Models in This File

nofly.executable.markdownDescription: The `nofly` CLI command, or an absolute path. For a repo checkout point it at the script, e.g. `node /path/to/NoFly.Agent/nofly.mjs` — a value ending in `.mjs`/`.js` is run with Node automatically.

nofly.checkOnSave.description: Run NoFly when you save an AI-artifact file (MCP config, Skill, rules, hook, …).

nofly.checkOnOpen.description: Run NoFly when you open OR switch to an AI-artifact file (not only on save).

nofly.checkModels.description: Scan source files (Python, notebooks, JS/TS) for AI models you load and flag any that are known-vulnerable in the NoFly Model Index — squiggled on the model-load line, on save and open.

nofly.checkWorkspaceOnStartup.description: Scan the whole workspace once when the window opens. Off by default so large repos don't pay it on every launch.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle:cli && npm run compile
